title: Anthropic prepares its IPO for October with a valuation of 2 trillion dollars
summary: The AI startup advances in its IPO process with the selection of Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs as lead coordinators.

title: Norway's sovereign wealth fund will drastically reduce its US Treasury bond portfolio
summary: The manager of the 2 trillion dollar fund proposes cutting its positions in US debt after reviewing its investment criteria.

title: US jobs report fuels fear of rate hikes and punishes markets
summary: August data reinforces bets on a September rate hike, sinking Wall Street and lifting the dollar and yields.

title: Tesla launches Cybercab robotaxi while canceling mass production for this year
summary: Elon Musk unveils the autonomous vehicle without pedals or steering wheel, though its volume production is postponed to 2027.

title: Volkswagen celebrates on the stock market its restructuring plan and analysts applaud its realism
summary: The German manufacturer agrees to cost and workforce cuts without factory closures, boosting its shares in Frankfurt and Madrid.
